calls.title: Funding Pips & GrowthBook Commercials
calls.summary: The team reached an agreement on a flexible pricing structure, including a $60,000 annual contract with a 30-day paid trial. Payment will be deferred for two months, followed by quarterly installments. The product integrates well with existing ClickHouse and Postgres systems, and is designed to support scalable experiments. Concerns regarding pricing tiers and incentives were discussed, with an emphasis on the importance of a trial period to validate product effectiveness. Onboarding will be expedited through dedicated support and setup processes. The meeting underscored the mutual desire to build trust and negotiate terms that accommodate both parties' needs, while highlighting the vendor's commitment to responsiveness and customization.
calls.keywords: experiment pricing, data warehouse integration, trial period, enterprise features, deferred payment, onboarding process
